comportamentos: Hold creation fails with the error class_enrollments_exist when class enrollments overlap the hold period: missing (the candidate instead destroys REGISTERED class enrollments, regardless of period)
Existing class enrollment requests for the held year/semester are set to INVALID after the hold is created or updated: missing
New ClassEnrollment and ClassEnrollmentRequest records fail validation with enrollment_is_held when the course class falls in a hold period: missing
CourseClass#start_date/end_date and EnrollmentHold.hold_in_date / active computed from dates (active column removed): missing
Student enrollment page shows a held message instead of the enroll link when the enrollment is held: missing
justificativa: The candidate silently deletes every registered class enrollment when a hold is created, whatever its period. The official fix instead rejects holds that overlap existing enrollments, invalidates pending requests and blocks enrollments during the hold, so the observable behavior differs sharply and most required changes are absent.
